captures.capture_method: Full available selected source result sets plus reused attributed evidence; explicit address review; new research phase capped at 30 pages Additional fixed-scope public address verification; all available association categories assessed where captured. Native IDs retained; exact repeated name/address observations held. Offices/dining anonymised.
captures.limitations: All 295 unique chamber directory cards captured; 122 contain explicit addresses in the publisher map data. Membership and address completion are selective. Coordinates were not used to infer membership. Only Darling Street addresses explicitly in Balmain count; Rozelle and Balmain East excluded. Street coverage and current trading remain unverified. Source listings may include upper floors, hotel or arcade units with explicit tenant street addresses; this is not a shopfront adjacency map. Missing businesses are unknown. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. Partial street evidence, not a premises census or verified current trading. Ranked Maps discovery is incomplete; association membership is not whole-street coverage. Unverified addresses and ambiguous services remain unknown. No absence inferred. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026.

captures.scope: Fixed named-street study: explicitly numbered Willoughby Road premises in Crows Nest, including explicitly addressed internal units. Exclude Pacific Highway, Burlington Street, Falcon Street, wider North Sydney/Willoughby suburbs, and locality-only mentions. Reuse the full saved North Sydney chamber directory before searching for a more comprehensive official precinct source. Collect all available categories, then apply this same address rule; no presumed brand affinity or proximity membership. Whole-street premises and current trading coverage remain unknown unless a source supplies a verifiable denominator.

additional_samples.scope: Only explicitly numbered, in-locality street records passing the unchanged boundary. Counts are listings, not premises.
additional_samples.overlap_with_other_sources: Unknown; do not add sample totals to other sources. Named office/dining records omitted.

captures.capture_method: Existing source reuse + three Google Maps UI search passes, explicit address checks, sampled overlapping map views, one bounded gap pass. Merge by identity/address; no proximity-based membership. Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required.
captures.limitations: Partial combined directory/map inventory. Three broad searches and sampled overlapping map views do not enumerate every premises. Search-result ends establish only that returned list, not street completeness. Missing businesses and categories remain unknown. Current listing and published hours are not verification of actual trading. Prior sources have mixed dates; absence from the new search never establishes closure. Office and dining names are omitted from working outputs. Broad service listings with unresolved activity are anonymised and counted separately, not assumed to be offices. Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained.

captures.capture_method: Browser DOM extraction of all 232 published cards across all available categories, with native listing URLs, source taxonomy and structured addresses. Apply one predeclared named-street/locality boundary; preserve source duplicates and address conflicts.
captures.limitations: All 232 published directory cards captured in normal browser across five batches (50/100/150/200/232), reconciling the 232 Results label and exhausted Load more control. 46 usable bounded records; all other records retained with scope/duplicate/address holds. All available council-directory records are captured, but free self-listing is opt-in, not a complete premises census. Source categories are publisher classifications, sometimes broad or inconsistent; delivery methods and gift-card participation are not retail activities. Duplicate source IDs/names are retained with explicit holds. Missing address fields are not filled from URL slugs. 225 Burns Bay Road records have conflicting Lane Cove/Lane Cove West labels across the source and are held outside the accepted locality pending reconciliation. Eyes 4 You is still at 24–28 in this directory, whereas the reused direct operator page gives 42 Burns Bay Road. The conflicting record is held without adding a second optical store or creating census membership. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Fixed named-street/locality study: explicitly numbered Boundary Street addresses in West End, including addressed internal business suites. Exclude Vulture Street, South Brisbane or Spring Hill Boundary Streets, other side streets and businesses inside the separately managed West Village property. A Boundary Street address for the West Village container does not establish streetfront tenancy membership. Reuse the accepted corridor and optical minimum. Seek a complete available all-category official council or trader directory before address filtering; record publisher coverage separately from the unknown street-premises denominator.

captures.capture_method: All-category regional chamber index enumerated before exact named-street address filtering; full in-scope profiles and prior official optical source reused. Reused addressed-business public map tags; native object type/ID/version, source edit/check dates and raw response retained. All returned named/addressed objects assessed uniformly across activities. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: Partial merged street-source inventory updated 2026-10-18. Earlier directory records retain their original dates, source identifiers and scope holds; newly addressed OpenStreetMap records are a community-maintained snapshot, not independently verified current tenants. A 3 km query radius discovers records only. Included map rows require numbered street and locality evidence, with the fixed Cronulla segment checked separately against documented intersections. Missing addresses/localities, known centre premises, suspected duplicate representations and near-boundary records are held. Map edit/check dates are not trading verification. Office and dining names are omitted. Count-only samples may overlap and are not added. Unsupported weekly hours remain unknown. No whole-street premises denominator, absence, ownership or historical co-tenancy is inferred.

Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. captures.limitations: Partial merged street-source inventory updated 2026-10-18. Earlier directory records retain their original dates, source identifiers and scope holds; newly addressed OpenStreetMap records are a community-maintained snapshot, not independently verified current tenants. A 3 km query radius discovers records only. Included map rows require numbered street and locality evidence, with the fixed Cronulla segment checked separately against documented intersections. Missing addresses/localities, known centre premises, suspected duplicate representations and near-boundary records are held. Map edit/check dates are not trading verification. Office and dining names are omitted. Count-only samples may overlap and are not added. Unsupported weekly hours remain unknown. No whole-street premises denominator, absence, ownership or historical co-tenancy is inferred. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained. Follow-up uses current mapped full profiles and separately dated frontage imagery; unresolved same-address aliases, managed-centre interiors and fixed-segment membership remain held. This remains a partial inventory with no known whole-street denominator or retailer-absence inference.
captures.capture_method: Reused addressed-business public map tags; native object type/ID/version, source edit/check dates and raw response retained. All returned named/addressed objects assessed uniformly across activities. Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required. Retained-address and frontage follow-up on 2026-10-20.

captures.capture_method: Complete advertised local directory pagination and uniform detail-page review; full visitor retail page; explicit address boundary and documented duplicate/conflict rules applied. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: Fixed numbered Bay Terrace/Wynnum study boundary was recorded before collection; explicit internal suites included, side streets and Manly excluded. Captured all 187 WynnumCentral listings through all 19 advertised pages, and all 32 mixed visitor-guide retail blocks without category/brand selection. Every WynnumCentral detail URL was attempted once; 182 succeeded and 5 timed out, retained without retries. Basic listings frequently expose only a name/category and no address. 20 business observations meet the fixed boundary; whole-street premises total and coverage percentage remain unknown. The sources are voluntary local publisher directories, not a council premises census; paid/free listing differences can bias address availability. Sobidah has conflicting Bay Terrace and Edith Street addresses and is held; the Health Hub Precinct and Manly Harbour Village are aggregate records held outside individual businesses. Simply Bella appears twice across publishers at the same address; both raw IDs retained with one observation. Some visitor entries have no precise activity category and remain unclassified. All retail sectors were considered, but absence of an in-scope category is unknown, never proof of absence. CMS dates and opening-hour tags do not verify current trading; several listings have old source modification dates. Current census Clacher and Hook membership and resident context are reused, with no new census points. No source-size or local shopper-catchment estimate is invented. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Named-street study: Jetty Road, Glenelg. Only explicit street/frontage addresses or accepted optical memberships; side streets and wider precinct listings excluded. No radius or walking catchment implied.

captures.capture_method: Existing source reuse + three Google Maps UI search passes, explicit address checks, sampled overlapping map views, one bounded gap pass. Merge by identity/address; no proximity-based membership.
captures.limitations: Partial combined directory/map inventory. Three broad searches and sampled overlapping map views do not enumerate every premises. Search-result ends establish only that returned list, not street completeness. Missing businesses and categories remain unknown. Current listing and published hours are not verification of actual trading. Prior sources have mixed dates; absence from the new search never establishes closure. Office and dining names are omitted from working outputs. Broad service listings with unresolved activity are anonymised and counted separately, not assumed to be offices. Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Named-street study: The Parade, Norwood. Only explicit street/frontage addresses or accepted optical memberships; side streets and wider precinct listings excluded. No radius or walking catchment implied.
captures.capture_method: First five official Shop, Taste and Live listing pages, plus first Kids/Parents, Nightlife and Sport/Recreation pages. Same publisher listing ID deduplicated across categories/pages; all raw appearances retained privately. Office and dining names omitted. Additional fixed-scope public address verification; all available association categories assessed where captured. Native IDs retained; exact repeated name/address observations held. Offices/dining anonymised. Retained public-profile address follow-up, 2026-10-24.
captures.limitations: Partial publisher capture, with pagination continuing beyond the selected pages. Broad categories include fashion, beauty, groceries, food, services, health, entertainment and other retail; alphabetical page order can bias which names are documented. Missing entries are unknown. Addresses must explicitly name The Parade and Norwood. Centre/arcade interiors and off-street premises held; no membership from proximity. Directory dates unknown; observed 18 October 2026, trading unverified. Anonymous counts are listings, not occupied units; do not add to other source samples. Partial street evidence, not a premises census or verified current trading. Ranked Maps discovery is incomplete; association membership is not whole-street coverage. Unverified addresses and ambiguous services remain unknown. No absence inferred. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026. Partial retained-candidate follow-up, not an all-frontage inventory. Store-in-store names are business observations, not distinct occupied premises. Unit-only corner addresses and separately named centre interiors remain held; no inferred absence or trading verification.

captures.capture_method: Existing source reuse + three Google Maps UI search passes, explicit address checks, sampled overlapping map views, one bounded gap pass. Merge by identity/address; no proximity-based membership.
captures.limitations: Partial combined directory/map inventory. Three broad searches and sampled overlapping map views do not enumerate every premises. Search-result ends establish only that returned list, not street completeness. Missing businesses and categories remain unknown. Current listing and published hours are not verification of actual trading. Prior sources have mixed dates; absence from the new search never establishes closure. Office and dining names are omitted from working outputs. Broad service listings with unresolved activity are anonymised and counted separately, not assumed to be offices. Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Prospect Road Village Heart study area: Prospect Road frontages between the Gladstone/Alpha intersections at the north and Buller/Ballville intersections at the south, including explicitly addressed internal premises. Side streets and other stretches of Prospect Road are outside this study. Exact corner frontage must be evidenced.

captures.capture_method: All 167 native member IDs from both public API pages, all linked detail pages; all rows of the two-page council dining guide; predeclared endpoint boundary and explicit mall/arcade membership applied. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive. Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required. Retained-address and frontage follow-up on 2026-10-20.
captures.limitations: Fixed Best Street–Stewart Street pedestrian segment recorded before collection, including explicitly identified Hub Arcade. Captured all 167 all-category chamber member detail pages and all 98 rows of the council dining guide. Chamber membership is voluntary, includes businesses outside Devonport and personal members, and is not a mall tenancy census. Dining guide is dated 15 May 2025 and covers food only. 11 unique in-scope observations qualify; the physical premises population and whole-mall coverage percentage are unknown. Other Rooke Street addresses are held unless mall or named-arcade membership is supported; street numbers and proximity do not establish membership. Three historical-only event-map mall listings remain supplementary and are not promoted to current observations. Source CMS modification dates do not verify trading. Exact current tenancy, all-category inventory, missing-category absence, GLA and a defined local catchment remain unknown. The broader Rooke Street corridor and its optical records and SA2 metrics are not silently copied into this narrower segment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained. Follow-up uses current mapped full profiles and separately dated frontage imagery; unresolved same-address aliases, managed-centre interiors and fixed-segment membership remain held. This remains a partial inventory with no known whole-street denominator or retailer-absence inference.

captures.scope: Pedestrian Rooke Street Mall, Devonport Tasmania: both mall-facing sides between Best Street and Stewart Street, as shown on the council busking/promotional-location map. Include premises whose publisher explicitly locates them in this mall, including internal arcades when mall membership is explicit. Exclude Rooke Street beyond the two endpoints, Market Square, side-street-only premises and unresolved addresses.

additional_samples.scope: Only included and listed records with an explicit professional-office category; business names omitted.
additional_samples.overlap_with_other_sources: Unknown; do not add this count to other source samples.

captures.capture_method: Full available selected source result sets plus reused attributed evidence; explicit address review; new research phase capped at 30 pages Additional fixed-scope public address verification; all available association categories assessed where captured. Native IDs retained; exact repeated name/address observations held. Offices/dining anonymised. Retained public-profile address follow-up, 2026-10-24.
captures.limitations: All 21 city-directory street-keyword hits retained. Seven new detail pages resolve tenant street addresses; two explicit street records reused from the prior full city capture. Arcade/unit addresses are labelled as such; these do not establish adjoining street frontage. Keyword hits without explicit addresses remain held. No full street premise total. Street coverage and current trading remain unverified. Source listings may include upper floors, hotel or arcade units with explicit tenant street addresses; this is not a shopfront adjacency map. Missing businesses are unknown. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. Partial street evidence, not a premises census or verified current trading. Ranked Maps discovery is incomplete; association membership is not whole-street coverage. Unverified addresses and ambiguous services remain unknown. No absence inferred. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026. Partial retained-candidate follow-up, not an all-frontage inventory. Store-in-store names are business observations, not distinct occupied premises. Unit-only corner addresses and separately named centre interiors remain held; no inferred absence or trading verification.

captures.scope: Named-street study: Church Street, Brighton. Only explicit street/frontage addresses or accepted optical memberships; side streets and wider precinct listings excluded. No radius or walking catchment implied.
captures.capture_method: Addressed OpenStreetMap snapshot: all returned activities assessed using fixed street/locality scope, raw IDs/version retained. Names of offices/dining omitted. Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required.
captures.limitations: Partial community-maintained source snapshot; not a complete street inventory, current-trading verification or absence evidence. Missing locality/number, duplicate and interior ambiguity held. Map edit/check dates are not trading checks. Anonymous samples may overlap; never add them. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained.

anonymous_counts.scope: Only explicitly numbered, in-locality street listings; not occupied-premises totals.

captures.capture_method: One automated Google Maps discovery sweep and one targeted gap/status pass; broad business and shop searches, four map views, full address checks, prior-record reconciliation
captures.limitations: Partial Google Maps business inventory, not a complete directory or verified shopfront census. Full listed addresses checked; four overlapping map views surveyed both sides. Search results omit businesses and include stale entries. Current physical trading, full premises denominator, vacant units, floor level and independent ownership are generally unknown. Includes upper floors and separately labelled offices. Corner addresses on other streets excluded. Missing businesses are unknown; no absence conclusions. Offices and hospitality appear only as counts; named observations exclude both. Office counts refer to business listings, not separate physical offices. Hospitality hours mean overlap with 09:00–17:00 or time after 17:00 on any published day; weekend-only daytime is flagged. Five unavailable schedules remain unknown. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Gertrude Street, Fitzroy, Nicholson Street to Smith Street, both sides. Explicit Gertrude Street addresses only; includes upper floors, retail, hospitality, services and separately labelled offices. Side-street corner venues excluded. No adjacency or catchment inferred.

captures.capture_method: All 14 published all-category directory pages; native post IDs reconciled to every detail page, structured addresses and descriptions. Fixed number/locality scope and explicit status/alias/conflict reviews applied.
captures.limitations: All 123 published association records across 14 pages and all 123 detail pages captured once, across all five source categories. The fixed numbered Racecourse Road boundary was saved before collection. 78 usable observations (78 classified non-optical) are business-listing evidence, not a unique occupied-premises count or verification of current trading. The directory includes side streets, addressed Newmarket Plaza shops, upper-floor services and public facilities; side streets and missing/conflicting addresses are held. Three evidenced aliases count once; an additional possible butcher alias stays held. Different named operators at shared premises remain separate published observations with succession/co-occupancy unknown. Two future and two temporarily closed source records do not count as present. Acher Pharmacy and Tiger Bread address conflicts remain held. Kensington Lawyers resolves to 301A through its own directory description. Source categories are broad and sometimes wrong: explicit business activities override grocery/retail tags for takeaway, liquor and a product supplier. Cellarbrations and Foodworks explicitly describe independently owned stores; other ownership remains unknown. Image publication timestamps are not business-status dates. Source geo points are retained only in raw evidence, not promoted as place coordinates or optical memberships. Whole-street population and coverage percentage are unknown, and no absence is inferred. Size and local-catchment demographics remain unknown; council special-rate finances are not retail scale. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Existing source reuse + three Google Maps UI search passes, explicit address checks, sampled overlapping map views, one bounded gap pass. Merge by identity/address; no proximity-based membership.
captures.limitations: Partial combined directory/map inventory. Three broad searches and sampled overlapping map views do not enumerate every premises. Search-result ends establish only that returned list, not street completeness. Missing businesses and categories remain unknown. Current listing and published hours are not verification of actual trading. Prior sources have mixed dates; absence from the new search never establishes closure. Office and dining names are omitted from working outputs. Broad service listings with unresolved activity are anonymised and counted separately, not assumed to be offices. Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Burwood Road street-frontage and explicitly addressed internal-suite listings within Hawthorn; Hawthorn East/3123, side streets and unresolved addresses excluded. Association directories are evidence sources, not the study boundary.

captures.capture_method: All published public Directorist records for the frontend directory type, native-ID/header reconciliation; all-category HTML and detail captures retained as cross-checks; fixed named-street scope applied.
captures.limitations: All 30 public published Directorist records in directory type 6 captured; API total and one-page header reconcile to the site count. The default page exposes 12 cards with no pagination; all 20 category filters and A–Z ordering expose 29 IDs. The API supplies the missing italktravel record and structured descriptions/addresses for four timed-out HTML details. 25 HTML detail pages are additionally preserved. HTML and API category assignments agree for all exposed IDs; the service-category HTML omits the additional API-only italktravel record, which remains outside the study boundary. Raw views are retained. 18 Macaulay Road/Kensington observations qualify, all 18 classified; side streets and an unpublished address are held. This member-funded association directory is not an address-complete street register. Raw API geographic fields and CMS expiry/modification dates do not verify a place coordinate, active business or current trading. Existing accepted Kensington Eyecare census membership and its 2026-09-01 source date remain unchanged; absence from the association list does not imply closure. Independent ownership is not established by family-owned language or a non-chain name. Historical May 2020 figures cover the centre plus connecting streets: about 65 tenancies and source-table totals of 4,157 sqm retail / 5,017 sqm total, with a separately listed 420 sqm vacant; these are not current GLA or this directory denominator. The source 7,000 residents within 500m is historical radius context, not a validated shopper catchment. Existing SA2 Kensington resident demographics (generalised display-polygon match) remain area background. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Both sides of the full named Puckle Street in Moonee Ponds. Include businesses explicitly addressed to Puckle Street or named corner frontage, including upper floors. Exclude Moonee Ponds Central interiors, arcades without established street frontage and all side-street/wider precinct businesses. Full available all-category association directory captured before uniform address filtering; no radius membership.

captures.capture_method: Full all-category association index and every detail profile; native taxonomy IDs; predeclared named-street scope and explicit duplicate/frontage reviews. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: All 195 available association-directory profiles captured once, with matching native index/detail IDs and source categories. This includes surrounding streets and associate members; 134 in-scope directory observations remain after explicit address, rear/arcade/centre and duplicate holds. Whole-street premises denominator unknown. Publisher category counts overlap and do not equal a premises total; its broader 350-plus marketing claim includes adjacent streets and lanes and cannot supply our denominator. Directory Verified badges do not establish independent current-trading verification. 140 profiles have no own description; source categories remain available. Amcal duplicate held; TS14+/Taking Shape same-unit alias unresolved; both Salon Envy profiles held pending frontage. Winey Cow/Rattlers at39, Maingrill/Via Boffe at74, Anytime/NAB at105–107 and other shared addresses may represent succession or separate uses, not verified distinct premises. No category or brand absence is inferred from this partial street inventory. Ownership follows the same source standard; broad goods/service categories stay combined. Current street GLA/visitation unavailable; existing resident-area demographics are not a shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Named-street study: Pakington Street, Newtown. Only explicit street/frontage addresses or accepted optical memberships; side streets and wider precinct listings excluded. No radius or walking catchment implied.
captures.capture_method: Addressed OpenStreetMap snapshot: all returned activities assessed using fixed street/locality scope, raw IDs/version retained. Names of offices/dining omitted. Additional fixed-scope public address verification; all available association categories assessed where captured. Native IDs retained; exact repeated name/address observations held. Offices/dining anonymised. Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required.
captures.limitations: Partial community-maintained source snapshot; not a complete street inventory, current-trading verification or absence evidence. Missing locality/number, duplicate and interior ambiguity held. Map edit/check dates are not trading checks. Anonymous samples may overlap; never add them. Partial street evidence, not a premises census or verified current trading. Ranked Maps discovery is incomplete; association membership is not whole-street coverage. Unverified addresses and ambiguous services remain unknown. No absence inferred. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained.

anonymous_counts.scope: Only explicitly numbered, in-locality street listings; not occupied-premises totals.

captures.capture_method: Existing source reuse + three Google Maps UI search passes, explicit address checks, sampled overlapping map views, one bounded gap pass. Merge by identity/address; no proximity-based membership.
captures.limitations: Partial combined directory/map inventory. Three broad searches and sampled overlapping map views do not enumerate every premises. Search-result ends establish only that returned list, not street completeness. Missing businesses and categories remain unknown. Current listing and published hours are not verification of actual trading. Prior sources have mixed dates; absence from the new search never establishes closure. Office and dining names are omitted from working outputs. Broad service listings with unresolved activity are anonymised and counted separately, not assumed to be offices. Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Numbered High Street addresses within Northcote (3070 where supplied), including explicitly addressed internal suites; side streets, other localities and unresolved addresses held. The Rise directory covers only a subsection of this study area.

captures.capture_method: Every native trader-item archive card across all parent and child categories; preserve source slugs, literal addresses and source taxonomy; apply the declared named-street boundary uniformly. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: Captured all 280 native trader cards across every published category on the council-endorsed association archive, with no directory pagination link in the source. 198 records have explicit numbered Bay Street / Port Melbourne addresses; other roads and one missing address are held. Entire association-directory capture is distinct from an unverified census of Bay Street premises: publisher membership, omissions, vacancies, duplicate occupied units and all individual trading dates are unknown. Upper-floor services are included as listed businesses, not claimed ground-floor shopfronts. Independent ownership remains unknown. No absence claims are made. Existing optical census membership and stale-source warnings remain separate from this fresh directory observation. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained.

captures.capture_method: Full legacy directory; complete current published membership API and all profiles; council visitor business/activity categories with complete discovered pagination, native-ID deduplication and full review of every addressed street profile. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: The Show Me corpus contains 1,334 rows across 22 broad categories, but its homepage still foregrounds COVID restrictions and individual update dates are absent. It remains historical discovery evidence. Of 73 syntactically numbered street leads, five have newer corresponding profiles and 68 have unresolved currency; six other street-named records lack street numbers and one has malformed number104106. The current business network publishes71 structured profiles across all three pages and an interim119-name roster:48 roster entries reconcile to profile IDs and71 retain no addressed profile. All71 profiles were read uniformly, supporting one numbered Maude Street entry. The council visitor source yielded172 unique IDs from463 card appearances across43 captured listing pages, including page-one aliases, across all See & Do and Eat & Drink listing sections and their pagination; eight addressed street profiles were read in full. Tourist-promotion eligibility and association membership are selective, so these nine supported listings are not a representative retail mix and do not cover every supermarket, service, health business or independent. Published categories are preserved; ownership is unknown unless explicitly stated. No absence is inferred. Existing two optical census memberships and stale source dates are unchanged; Specsavers source is used only to resolve street identity. Existing Shepparton-North SA2 resident data is broader generalised-polygon context, not a measured shopper catchment. Tourism brochure counts describing the whole region are not used as a street denominator. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete published CMS pagination for both publicly accessible directories, preserving native IDs, source addresses and taxonomies; apply one predeclared literal street boundary and explicit overlap holds. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: Captured all 337 published records and 115 category terms from the independent Visit South Melbourne guide, plus all 12 available association records. 59 observations meet the predeclared numbered Clarendon Street / South Melbourne boundary after address, aggregate-property, facility and cross-publisher overlap holds. The independent guide is not an official council directory; the association directory is participation-based. Full publisher extraction is not full street-premises coverage. Internal addressed premises are included but not asserted to have street-level frontage. Missing source-locality text on association records is supported only by its explicit South Melb. Traders tag. The Mirror Mirror locality/postcode conflict remains held; Tesla charging facility and the aggregate Clarendon Centre property are excluded from business counts, and its category tags do not establish individual supermarket tenants. Seven cross-publisher overlaps are held, with native IDs and reasons retained; Chill Sports unit/range remains unresolved. CMS publish, expiry, never-expired, research-status and modification fields are not trading verification. Category shares describe these publishers’ selected listings, not the whole street, and must not be compared directly with complete centre inventories. Unlisted brands, current trading, historical co-tenants, independent ownership and true premises denominator remain unknown. Existing three accepted optical outlets are retained separately; their omission from these publisher lists is not absence or closure. Reused SA2 resident figures are not street shopper catchment or demand. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete association A–Z page and every full profile, reconciled native WordPress IDs; explicit street-address scope declared before collection. Additional fixed-scope public address verification; all available association categories assessed where captured. Native IDs retained; exact repeated name/address observations held. Offices/dining anonymised.
captures.limitations: All 165 official business-association directory cards and full profiles captured with matching native WordPress IDs, source categories, descriptions and literal addresses; no pagination. Declared whole named-street scope accepts 78 business/service listings, including upper floors, and holds 87 side-street or interior/property records. Acland Court itself and its internal/address-unresolved tenants are held; its 158 address does not prove frontage. Nearby Luna Park, Barkly/foreshore businesses and other streets are not joined. Same-address Cotton On/Yo-Bar records retained without asserting distinct premises or resolving possible succession. Complete publisher capture is not whole-street census coverage; no street premises total, vacancies or absence inferred. Full retail/food/services/health/entertainment/fashion/beauty scope used uniformly. Readings is explicitly described as an independent Australian retailer; chain-level claim retained, outlet ownership still unknown under existing feature standard. Source scope/classification is not verified trading. St Kilda–West resident-area statistics retained as context, not a measured shopper catchment; no current GLA or footfall established. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. Partial street evidence, not a premises census or verified current trading. Ranked Maps discovery is incomplete; association membership is not whole-street coverage. Unverified addresses and ambiguous services remain unknown. No absence inferred. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026.

captures.capture_method: Complete council category tables and chamber membership slots; exact name/address deduplication with raw identifiers retained; uniform freshness checks for every fixed-boundary council lead. Reused addressed-business public map tags; native object type/ID/version, source edit/check dates and raw response retained. All returned named/addressed objects assessed uniformly across activities. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive. Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required. Retained-address and frontage follow-up on 2026-10-20.
captures.limitations: Partial merged street-source inventory updated 2026-10-18. Earlier directory records retain their original dates, source identifiers and scope holds; newly addressed OpenStreetMap records are a community-maintained snapshot, not independently verified current tenants. A 3 km query radius discovers records only. Included map rows require numbered street and locality evidence, with the fixed Cronulla segment checked separately against documented intersections. Missing addresses/localities, known centre premises, suspected duplicate representations and near-boundary records are held. Map edit/check dates are not trading verification. Office and dining names are omitted. Count-only samples may overlap and are not added. Unsupported weekly hours remain unknown. No whole-street premises denominator, absence, ownership or historical co-tenancy is inferred. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained. Follow-up uses current mapped full profiles and separately dated frontage imagery; unresolved same-address aliases, managed-centre interiors and fixed-segment membership remain held. This remains a partial inventory with no known whole-street denominator or retailer-absence inference.

captures.capture_method: Complete published association native-ID index plus all advertised HTML pages, uniform missing-profile and potential-street profile checks, conservative address and category exception review. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
captures.limitations: Captured all 561 published association member IDs through six API pages with reconciled totals and all 85 business categories plus 12 membership types. All 32 advertised HTML pages yielded 561 cards but only 360 distinct IDs, with 201 repeated occurrences and 201 missing IDs: page coverage was not record completeness. Every missing profile and every potentially Sturt-addressed HTML card was checked uniformly: 236 successful profile captures. 39 observations qualify conservatively within the fixed street scope, 37 classified non-optical and no directory optical records. Three outer-street records remain suburb-boundary unknown even after operator checks; The Park Hotel is explicitly Alfredton and The Forge identifies its Alfredton branch. Two postcode3354 conflicts, a Ballarat Central/Melbourne field conflict, side streets, other localities and missing addresses remain held. Generic Ballarat postal/city labels are not independently surveyed suburb or frontage boundaries. The association is not an address-complete street inventory, so whole-street denominator and all missing-feature absences remain unknown. Schools, offices, community organisations, internal units and upper floors are included where the scope is supported; records are not unique ground-floor tenancies. Source taxonomy has demonstrable errors: health labels on a pub and Cellars, trades/manufacturing on a bakery, and tourism on a retailer. Raw taxonomy retained; explicit descriptions/activity names used conservatively, otherwise category unknown. Blue Illusion and Midtown Cellars remain unclassified. Current independent ownership is unverified; local/family ownership and a historical buying-group account are not treated as proof. Existing two optical census memberships and dates remain unchanged. Sturt Optical operator page confirms Ballarat but conflicts between731 and732; exact unit not resolved. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Named-street study: Market Street, Fremantle. Only explicit street/frontage addresses or accepted optical memberships; side streets and wider precinct listings excluded. No radius or walking catchment implied.

captures.capture_method: Attempted all published top-level category archives once; retained the only enumerated indexed archive listing as a held stale-source record. No selective retailer supplementation. Reused addressed-business public map tags; native object type/ID/version, source edit/check dates and raw response retained. All returned named/addressed objects assessed uniformly across activities.
captures.limitations: Partial merged street-source inventory updated 2026-10-18. Earlier directory records retain their original dates, source identifiers and scope holds; newly addressed OpenStreetMap records are a community-maintained snapshot, not independently verified current tenants. A 3 km query radius discovers records only. Included map rows require numbered street and locality evidence, with the fixed Cronulla segment checked separately against documented intersections. Missing addresses/localities, known centre premises, suspected duplicate representations and near-boundary records are held. Map edit/check dates are not trading verification. Office and dining names are omitted. Count-only samples may overlap and are not added. Unsupported weekly hours remain unknown. No whole-street premises denominator, absence, ownership or historical co-tenancy is inferred.

captures.scope: Named-street study using explicit addresses in the recorded locality. Wider precinct and side-street listings remain held.

additional_samples.scope: Only explicitly numbered, in-locality street records passing the unchanged boundary. Counts are listings, not premises.
additional_samples.overlap_with_other_sources: Unknown; do not add sample totals to other sources. Named office/dining records omitted.

captures.capture_method: Existing source reuse + three Google Maps UI search passes, explicit address checks, sampled overlapping map views, one bounded gap pass. Merge by identity/address; no proximity-based membership.
captures.limitations: Partial combined directory/map inventory. Three broad searches and sampled overlapping map views do not enumerate every premises. Search-result ends establish only that returned list, not street completeness. Missing businesses and categories remain unknown. Current listing and published hours are not verification of actual trading. Prior sources have mixed dates; absence from the new search never establishes closure. Office and dining names are omitted from working outputs. Broad service listings with unresolved activity are anonymised and counted separately, not assumed to be offices. Counts are business listings, not physical tenancies or office units; shared addresses, virtual offices and unresolved identities are held separately. Weekday and weekend hours differ; daytime means any overlap with 09:00–17:00, evening means after 17:00. Counts do not measure intensity, foot traffic or commercial performance. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

Map markers reconcile to profile names but dining/services maps show only 11/42 and 10/93; map pins alone would severely undercount. 141 in-scope current directory listings; 128 side-street/address/facility holds. captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Reused live Westfield DOM extraction through every next-page control; all category filters joined by native store ID; every uncategorised listing received an official detail-page review.
captures.limitations: All 9 unfiltered A–Z pages and all 33 source category filters (38 settled pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 207 native publisher listings; five facility records retained outside 202 business observations: parcel locker, concierge, gift card, prize desk and Woden Gardenland playground. Every uncategorised business detail was read: Pillow Talk explicitly sells bedding/furniture/decor and Tobacconist & Co tobacco/shisha; these descriptions support their categories. Source category combinations remain publisher classifications without presumed affinity or ownership. All native IDs retained, including two Big Barber, two Mister Minit, separately labelled Lovisa levels and St George versus Westpac & St.George; these are not assumed to be distinct occupied tenancies or collapsed without evidence. Five optical listings agree with the existing accepted census; census IDs, membership and stale-source flags remain unchanged. The owner roughly-224 specialty-store statement and older 239-tenant scale note use different dates/definitions from the live 207 listings and are not occupancy/completeness denominators. Existing source-attributed 72,800 m² scale note is retained without inventing a current measurement date. Phillip SA2 statistics describe residents, not the centre catchment. Owner over-529,000 total-trade-area population and 2025 expenditure estimates remain background because the relevant boundary map was not captured; its Sydney Metro comparison for Woden is a source inconsistency requiring clarification. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all captured names and possible fascia variants in the complete publisher directory. No listing found; absence is confined to this captured directory, not independently verified physical trading absence.

captures.capture_method: Reused Vicinity structured-directory extraction; complete native store and category arrays; full published shopping/food cards; exact reconciliation against server-rendered links and live browser URL sets.
captures.limitations: All 243 native directory IDs reconciled between both global arrays, complete shopping/food CMS cards and the rendered union of 196 shopping plus 59 food links. 240 usable business listings; two ATMs are facilities and Al Sultan Perfumery is explicitly coming soon. All available source descriptions were extracted uniformly; 42 are blank. 234 usable non-optical listings have conservative source-supported categories; original combined communication/electronics/games, music/DVD/books, liquor/tobacco and sport/fitness/outdoors labels remain combined. Source categories can be broad or inconsistent; raw categories are preserved, and BWS fresh-food tagging is overridden by its explicit drinks description. 6 directory optical listings are distinct from the unchanged two accepted census outlets; no proximity or new census mapping. Bupa generic corporate optical wording does not prove an optical store at this premises. Repeated Eastern Delights and Sushi Hub names retain distinct native IDs/URLs; USA Nails variants and car washes also stay separate, without claiming a verified physical-tenancy count. No independent ownership inferred; family ownership alone does not establish independence. Existing dated portfolio GLA reused; owner figures dated 31 December 2025 (78,575 m² GLA, 14.5m annual visits and 509,910 total trade-area population) do not supply a captured catchment boundary or traffic period/method. Forward-looking office/residential development and stale expected-completion language are not current completed-stock evidence. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: All items of the official Sitecore StoreDirectory component; unique native IDs and full unfiltered component array retained. Navigation, featured stores and articles excluded.
captures.limitations: Completeness is to the available store-directory component, not every physical tenancy. Shopping-only category labels remain broad; product marketing tags are not treated as separate tenants. Directory capture does not independently verify current trading or occupied premises. No ownership is inferred.
captures.scope: Named canonical shopping-centre directory; neighbouring properties excluded.

Current rendered business-profile and retained-address verification continuation, 2026-10-20; targeted dated frontage imagery where required.
captures.limitations: Partial merged street-source inventory updated 2026-10-18. Earlier directory records retain their original dates, source identifiers and scope holds; newly addressed OpenStreetMap records are a community-maintained snapshot, not independently verified current tenants. A 3 km query radius discovers records only. Included map rows require numbered street and locality evidence, with the fixed Cronulla segment checked separately against documented intersections. Missing addresses/localities, known centre premises, suspected duplicate representations and near-boundary records are held. Map edit/check dates are not trading verification. Office and dining names are omitted. Count-only samples may overlap and are not added. Unsupported weekly hours remain unknown. No whole-street premises denominator, absence, ownership or historical co-tenancy is inferred. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained.

Current independents, supermarket presence/absence, GLA and defined local catchment remain unproven within this street sample. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. The 2026-10-20 continuation is partial discovery/address verification, not a frontage-by-frontage census. Ranked search results and retained selections may omit businesses or categories. No complete street denominator, inferred vacancy, independent ownership or field-verified trading claim. Current-source dates and older imagery dates remain separate. Fixed scope/locality exclusions retained. Follow-up uses current mapped full profiles and separately dated frontage imagery; unresolved same-address aliases, managed-centre interiors and fixed-segment membership remain held. captures.capture_method: Rendered unfiltered official directory expanded to its published total; source URL identities deduplicated and counters reconciled.
captures.limitations: Complete available official publisher collection captured; not independently verified daily trading or an occupied-premises census. No operator absence inferred. Unclassified categories stay unknown. Erina cached first page originally reported274; live pages reported276. Fresh live page1 reconciles all276 unique URLs; a Copy-labelled listing remains held.
captures.scope: Canonical Erina Fair official directory; all available shopping, dining and services records assessed. Neighbouring properties excluded; explicit out-of-scope and future/uncertain records retained in source history.

captures.capture_method: Reused GPT/Algolia extractor with all current public frontend filters; paginated 100 at a time through every reported page, retaining all native IDs and source category fields.
captures.limitations: All 304 official searchable listings captured over 4 API pages, reconciled to nbHits and unique objectID. Official frontend channel, publication-window and exclusion filters reused. All ten main categories and their subcategories retained. Seven explicitly coming-soon listings remain visible and do not count as present. Source category mappings can be broad or inconsistent (Event Cinemas and Kingpin are tagged Retail Services including Banks); source membership is retained, not treated as an independent activity audit. Explicit cinema wording additionally supports entertainment presence. Existing accepted iContact membership has current operator evidence from the prior repair but is omitted from this directory; omission does not establish closure. Sunglass Hut is a directory observation only, not an automatically promoted census member. GPT currently publishes 108100 square metres but does not state its measurement period on the property page. Resident-area figures are not catchment evidence, and Narellan/Ed.Square overlap remains unmeasured. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Reused official frontend search-index extraction, same published channel and publication-window/exclusion filters; unfiltered categories and complete unique objectID/source-total reconciliation.
captures.limitations: All available published index records captured across every directory category. Source categories, native IDs and directory statuses retained. Combined category labels remain combined. Facilities are held separately; repeated fascias with distinct native IDs are retained as separate listings. Posted location labels do not independently verify current trading, shopfront coordinates, occupied-tenancy totals or independent ownership.
captures.scope: Official canonical shopping-centre directory across shopping, food and services; neighbouring properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Complete unfiltered server-rendered directory; native Storedetail IDs reconciled to every data-mapdata location across two levels; repeated category rows merged by ID.
captures.limitations: All unfiltered official directory cards reconciled by native Storedetail ID and their explicit map-shape link to all map records. Five dining map rows use article URLs; their map-shape links on the directory cards provide the join across both levels. Repeated map rows are category memberships, merged by store ID while preserving raw shape/level IDs and source category labels. Different native IDs with the same name remain distinct source listings, not assumed duplicate physical premises. Includes food, fashion, grocery, health, beauty, services, offices, entertainment and unbranded businesses. All categories are covered; independent ownership is unknown. Source category Health, Sport & Fitness includes sports retailers and is broad activity evidence, not a count of clinical providers. Old source dates and the accepted six-store optical census are retained; this directory is not a census status refresh. Existing 71,800 m² GLA has unknown measurement period; resident SA2 demographics are not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all captured names and possible fascia variants in the complete publisher directory. No listing found; absence is confined to this captured directory, not independently verified physical trading absence.

captures.capture_method: Reused public GPT/Algolia extractor, all pages with current frontend filters, every source category retained, exact full live-browser URL and name reconciliation.
captures.limitations: All 281 native records across 3 API pages match the complete rendered URL and name list. Current frontend channel, publication-window and exclusion filters reused; 11 main categories and all available subcategories retained. 240 unflagged business/service listings; 40 explicitly future-opening records and Lee Massage reopening 29 October are held separately. Source categories are broad, including combined health/beauty and home/technology; no ownership inferred. Three uncategorised future entries remain held. Two Forever New records retain distinct IDs/URLs and both future flags, without claiming separate occupied shops. Civic, library, education and professional services are included as publisher-listed premises. Six directory optical listings are separate from the five unchanged accepted census outlets; Sunglass Hut requires ordinary eligibility review. Complete directory coverage does not prove current or historical trading. The expansion announcement mixes new and returning brands; unflagged existing listings are not all treated as closed or future merely because named there. The published 29 October 2026 opening is future at capture. More than 10,500 m² announced additional space is not completed current GLA; do not add it to existing dated 70,100 m² portfolio evidence. The owner current page says Size 70,100sqm with no new measurement period. Schofields East SA2 residents are not a measured centre catchment; no source-supported overlap or catchment demographics established. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all captured names and possible fascia variants in the complete publisher directory. No listing found; absence is confined to this captured directory, not independently verified physical trading absence.

captures.capture_method: Full unfiltered server-rendered and live DOM directory, all category tokens, every linked detail page, canonical redirect deduplication and complete dated PDF directory reconciliation.
captures.limitations: All 102 primary directory cards and 17 category labels captured; every linked detail page fetched once with native WordPress ID, canonical URL and complete available description. One Flower Village alias redirects to the identical St Ives Flower Village post 1651 and is held, leaving 101 usable premises listings, 98 classified non-optical and three directory optical entries matching the unchanged accepted census. Published category combinations remain combined. Porter Liquor explicitly claims independently owned and operated; ownership is unknown for other tenants, and centre-level independent ownership is not assigned to them. MrK opening-soon URL slug is historical, with no current future flag in the title/description; hours do not verify trading. The currently linked map is visibly dated February 2026: 142 category rows collapse to 103 name/location records, including four unmatched dated businesses (R.M.Williams, Elm Lifestyle, Z&Y Cashmere and Silks, Ugg Express), two concessions inside Harris Farm and one concierge facility. R.M.Williams and Elm Lifestyle share shop 30 on the map, an unresolved source inconsistency. Map-only names remain unknown for current presence rather than promoted from older evidence; host detail explicitly supports the two Harris Farm concessions without counting extra standalone premises. Full live-directory coverage is not independent physical occupancy or current/historical trading verification. Size/GLA remains unknown. Leasing copy claims more than 6.6m yearly visitors without a reference year or method; it is not a comparable traffic measure or local catchment. Existing St Ives SA2 resident context and census stale-source warnings are retained unchanged. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Rendered unfiltered official directory expanded to its published total; source URL identities deduplicated and counters reconciled.
captures.limitations: Complete available official publisher collection captured; not independently verified daily trading or an occupied-premises census. No operator absence inferred. Unclassified categories stay unknown. All native directory names retained; category labels not exposed on these cards remain unknown.
captures.scope: Canonical Stockland Green Hills Shopping Centre official directory; all available shopping, dining and services records assessed. Neighbouring properties excluded; explicit out-of-scope and future/uncertain records retained in source history.

captures.capture_method: Reused bounded public-source capture and native-ID normalization. Exact full live-directory/API reconciliation; all available category terms and every linked official detail page extracted uniformly.
captures.limitations: Complete live directory shows 181 of 181 stores and matches all 181 unique native IDs/URLs in its page-published API. All 40 source categories retained; 29 source listings are uncategorised. Every linked detail page was captured once; five descriptions are blank. 173 classified non-optical listings and 6 optical directory entries, with unclassified businesses retained: Phone Mastermind, Mobile Pit. Dining Precinct is a location tag, not automatic food classification; all combined source categories remain combined. No independent ownership inferred from locally/Australian/family owned wording. Indian Beauty Secrets, KFC, Mobile Pit and Route 66 variants have distinct source IDs and SAP shop references; St George Bank and Westpac share one SAP reference, unresolved as physical tenancies. Civic childcare and library premises are included. All are publisher-listed only; no current or historical trading verification, and generic daily Closed now labels are not closure evidence. Six directory optics remain separate from four accepted census outlets. Existing source-attributed 63,870 m² GLA and 184 specialty-tenancy metric dated 30 June 2023 are reused, not new measurements or this directory coverage denominator. Greenfield Park–Prairiewood SA2 residents are background, not a centre catchment; no demographics or coordinates invented. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Reused Vicinity frontend extractor: parsed the single window.__data.websiteData.stores array and resolved every supplied category/subcategory UUID from the same payload.
captures.limitations: Complete official frontend websiteData.stores array across shopping, dining and services; publisher UUIDs and taxonomy IDs retained. Directory entries include services, ATMs and optional posted hours; this is not an independently verified occupied-shop count or confirmation that each tenant is currently trading. Broad source category labels stay broad. Independent ownership is unknown unless explicitly evidenced. Existing dated GLA and resident-area evidence is retained without treating regional data as a local catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction, following each visible next-page control through terminal page. Stable store identifiers preserved; every published category filter captured and joined by publisher ID.
captures.limitations: All 10 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (38 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 228 publisher listings, with 4 facility records retained outside business observations: Concierge, gift card, prize collection desk and parcel locker. Australia Post and commercial Concierge Car Wash remain included. This is the accepted Burwood NSW centre directory, distinct from Burwood Plaza and Victorian Burwood destinations. Native store IDs and all published category memberships are preserved. Source categories can overlap or be broad; no presumed affinity or independent ownership is inferred. Transient partial renders and repeated checks are retained in raw evidence; only the settled full pagination enters comparison. Complete publisher enumeration is separate from verified individual trading and occupied physical tenancies. The dated compendium values of 63,200 m² GLA and 227 businesses are preserved as different measures and periods, not the current directory denominator. Eight optical directory listings include Sunglass Hut; the existing seven accepted census outlets remain unchanged. The previously repaired OWNDAYS membership is reused, and no new coordinate or competition membership is created. Burwood NSW resident-area context is not a measured centre catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Chatswood directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Full live browser pagination, all category filters, native-ID reconciliation and uniform review of uncategorised entries/facilities/duplicate names.
captures.limitations: Complete live unfiltered pagination and all 33 category filters captured with native-ID joins: 229 source listings, five centre facilities held, 224 usable business/service listings. All otherwise uncategorised businesses reviewed using their own official descriptions. Cincotta Chemist has two explicit levels and different phone numbers, so both native records retained. Concierge Carwash is a business; parcel locker, concierge, gift-card/prize desks and recycling points are facilities. Two transient category loading states retained but excluded; settled recaptures used. Source product categories may overlap and Entertainment includes retail products as well as venues; counts do not measure leisure floor area or distinct tenancies. Independent ownership and individual trading unverified. The owner approximately 246 specialties and prior compendium tenancy figure differ from live published listings and are not extraction denominators. Existing attributed 83,000 sqm GLA retained with its date. Owner 2025 transaction-defined trade-area estimates and February 2026 webpage currency are background; boundary map not captured and local SA2 residents are not the catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Existing accepted canonical Westfield Eastgardens. Capture complete unfiltered official centre directory and all published category filters, preserving native IDs; centre facilities and future listings held separately. No nearby tenancy joins. Reuse prior four selective observations as historical evidence, not an extraction denominator.

captures.capture_method: Reused live Westfield DOM extraction through every next-page control; all category filters joined by native store ID; every uncategorised listing received an official detail-page review.
captures.limitations: All 10 unfiltered A–Z pages and all 30 category filters (37 pages) captured. 235 native publisher listings; five facilities held separately: parcel locker, concierge, gift card, prize desk and recycling point. Sports and Spectators explicitly says Opening Soon on its detail page despite an unflagged directory card. Little Amigos is the sole uncategorised business; paid play supports Entertainment without inferring a separate food retailer from complimentary drinks. The Family Co is a described support-service premises, with undated opening text retained. All native IDs and source category combinations are preserved; independent ownership remains unknown. Seven directory optical listings are distinct from five unchanged accepted census outlets; OWNDAYS and Sunglass Hut require normal census review. Owner approximately 227 specialty stores and older 234-tenant note use different dates and definitions, not coverage denominators. Existing 61,000 m² source-attributed GLA is reused, not a new current measurement. Hurstville Central SA2 residents are not a centre catchment. Owner over-379,000 total-trade-area population and 2025 expenditure estimates remain background; transaction-defined boundary map was not captured and source metrics are current as February 2026. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Kotara directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction through every visible next-page control; all published category filters joined by exact native store ID. Explicit ATM detail used to classify that facility separately.
captures.limitations: All 13 unfiltered A–Z pages and all 31 source category filters (39 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 290 native publisher listings, with five facility records retained outside the 285 business observations: concierge, gift card, prize collection desk, parcel locker and Bit Rocket crypto-ATM (explicit publisher detail description). Commercial car washes and Australia Post remain included. Source categories may overlap or be broad; no presumed affinity or ownership is inferred. Lovabra has no captured source category and remains unclassified. All native IDs are preserved, including separately listed floors of the same operator; source listings are not physical-tenancy counts or verified current trading. Raw transient category renders are retained but only settled URL/category pairs enter analysis. Eight directory optical listings match the existing accepted inventory; prior City Specs, Custom Eyes and Zoom repairs are reused rather than repeated. The 83,000 m² dated GLA evidence is retained, not treated as a current tenant denominator. Liverpool East resident-area figures are not a measured centre catchment; Ed.Square and surrounding Liverpool practices remain separate. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
