captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Miranda directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction, following each visible next-page control through terminal page. Stable store identifiers preserved; every published category filter captured and joined by publisher ID.
captures.limitations: All 17 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (45 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 398 publisher listings, including 5 non-tenant centre services retained but excluded from tenant observations. Same-name listings with different publisher IDs remain separate because distinct units have not been reconciled. Published category membership can be broad or surprising and is retained without brand-affinity overrides; this is publisher classification, not an independent activity audit. Category pages sometimes reset the dropdown display after pagination; classification follows the actual URL path linked from the verified first-page category, not the reset control or stale requested-category transport field. Transient empty loading captures are retained as raw evidence but are not empty-directory findings. All source IDs reconciled against the unfiltered list. Source counts are listings, not occupied physical tenancies. Earlier centre captures retain their original scopes; the five centre-service exclusions here must be considered when comparing listing/category shares. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction, following each visible next-page control through terminal page. Stable store identifiers preserved; every published category filter captured and joined by publisher ID.
captures.limitations: All 12 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (44 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 288 publisher listings, including 4 non-tenant centre services retained but excluded from tenant observations. Same-name listings with different publisher IDs remain separate because distinct units have not been reconciled. Published category membership can be broad or surprising and is retained without brand-affinity overrides; this is publisher classification, not an independent activity audit. Category pages sometimes reset the dropdown display after pagination; classification follows the actual URL path linked from the verified first-page category, not the reset control or stale requested-category transport field. Transient empty loading captures are retained as raw evidence but are not empty-directory findings. All source IDs reconciled against the unfiltered list. Source counts are listings, not occupied physical tenancies. Earlier centre captures retain their original scopes; the four facility exclusions here must be considered when comparing listing/category shares. Australia Post Parcel Locker is a facility, while the commercial Concierge Car Wash remains a service business. The publisher includes Borec House listings; these are explicitly directory-supported businesses, not proximity additions. Two City Optics source IDs are retained as unresolved related/duplicate listings and do not create an extra census store. Sunglass Hut K21 remains separate from any unverified Myer concession. Directory source categories are unusually broad in places, including one City Optics record under Food and drink; no activity claim is inferred beyond the optical listing role. captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all names and possible fascia variants in the fully captured shopping, food and service directory. No listing found. Scoped to captured publisher listings, not verified physical absence or trading status.

captures.capture_method: Reused Vicinity structured-directory parser; all native arrays, full shopping/dining cards and rendered links reconciled, plus one native-only ATM detail.
captures.limitations: All 155 native IDs in both global directory arrays were captured; shopping/dining cards and server-rendered links cover 154 of them, with the extra Commonwealth Bank ATM retained from its explicit native detail page. Shopping and dining overlap by 4 IDs. 145 listed businesses enter presence; 10 facilities are retained separately. All available CMS descriptions extracted uniformly; 6 blank. 141 usable non-optical listings classified; 4 directory optical businesses remain distinct from the unchanged four accepted census outlets. Source taxonomy is broad and inconsistent: department stores and supermarkets receive health, beauty and services tags; optometry/health, health products/services, entertainment, travel goods/services, music/DVD/books and sport/fitness/outdoors categories remain explicitly broad or combined. A broad tag does not verify a clinical service or entertainment venue. BWS liquor classification follows its explicit bottle-shop description. No independent ownership is inferred; stocking independent brands does not establish independent ownership. Distinct native IDs for PTC, KFC and other variants are retained without claiming a verified physical-tenancy count. Reused GLA 53,190 m² is dated 31 December 2025. Owner 7.9m annual visits and 307,145 total trade-area population are dated context with no captured traffic period/method or catchment boundary; existing Browns Plains ABS SA2 population/income is resident-area context only. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Grand Plaza shopping-centre property, 27–49 Browns Plains Road, Browns Plains QLD 4118; complete available official shopping and dining directories and underlying native store array. Nearby Browns Plains homemaker, Village Square and other separately managed centres are excluded.

captures.capture_method: Server-rendered complete A–Z native WordPress post IDs and category classes, reconciled to all linked descriptions and dining subset.
captures.limitations: Complete unfiltered official A–Z directory: 164 native store post IDs, each reconciled to its canonical detail URL; all 25 dining-directory URLs are included. Full descriptions captured uniformly, with JB Hi-Fi blank. 158 usable business listings; four ATMs plus JP and Police Beat retained as six facilities outside the business denominator. 151 classified non-optical and 7 directory optics remain separate from six accepted census outlets; directory Sunglass Hut does not silently create a census membership. Three listings have no source category (Allsorts Of Sweets, BWS and Liquorland), classified only by explicit descriptions. Mislabelled Flight Centre/Greg Lewis/iPlay, fresh-food-tagged dining outlets and beauty retailers are corrected from their captured descriptions while raw taxonomy is retained; Bupa insurance remains separate from Bupa Optical. Adairs independent-retailer marketing and family/local ownership do not establish independent-business ownership. Existing exact-listing categories reused without selecting tenants by brand affinity. Directory source count is not owner 172 tenants or over-170 marketing. Owner 51,972 GLAR and 73,080 site-area values lack stated units and measurement dates, so no square-metre value invented. Same leasing page reports 10.3m annual foot traffic and 9.5m annual visitors with no dates/method, so neither selected as current. $585m MAT and 3.7% expenditure growth to 2036 retain unknown period/boundary; growth is a forecast. Brochure contact form not submitted. Existing Cairns City SA2 data remain resident background, not the centre catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Cairns Central managed shopping-centre property at 1–21 McLeod Street, Cairns City QLD 4870. Entire official alphabetical store directory, including dining and services; surrounding CBD businesses and other Cairns centres excluded.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all captured names and possible fascia variants in the complete publisher directory. No listing found; absence is confined to this captured directory, not independently verified physical trading absence.

captures.capture_method: Complete server-rendered A–Z directory and all category archives, reconciled to every linked official detail page and stable WordPress post ID. Sequential one-attempt detail capture with pacing.
captures.limitations: Captured all 185 available A–Z directory cards, every linked detail page and all 15 official category filters; exact unique native post IDs reconcile with URLs. No category-only extras or missing descriptions. 183 usable businesses, 176 classified non-optical and 7 optical directory listings; ATM and Police Beat remain facilities. Department/fashion/food/health/services and all small-business listings are covered uniformly. Combined books/stationery/gifts, entertainment/hobbies/activities, home/technology and broad health/fitness labels remain explicit. Only the arcade description establishes Timezone as a venue. Local/family ownership is not inferred as independent ownership. Seven accepted census optics remain unchanged: directory adds Sunglass Hut while describing Westfund as insurance, so equal counts do not imply identical inventories. Repeated related fascia and native IDs are source listings, not a verified physical-tenancy denominator. Homepage over 200 retailers, About over 180 and leasing 163 specialty stores differ from 185 available records; none overrides capture coverage. Previously attributed 65,864 m² GLA is retained with a caution that current page omits measurement date/unit; 7 December 2022 sale release reports 65,964 sqm centre area without explicitly defining GLA. These are unresolved measures, not evidence of 100 m² physical shrinkage. Undated 5.76m annual traffic and conflicting trade-area claims (155,030 December 2021,163,000+ undated,175,000+ service population in 2022;178,980 forecast 2036) are not current comparable catchment measures. Existing resident SA2 metrics remain background. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

Source activity labels and explicit activity descriptions support broad categories; opaque labels remain unknown. captures.scope: Official named shopping-centre directory across all categories; surrounding properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Complete unfiltered all-category HTML cards with explicit category slugs; every profile attempted once, successful native IDs/descriptions reconciled and all failures retained.
captures.limitations: Complete primary directory:216 unique retailer URLs and all13 advertised category labels;19 raw slugs include six retailer-specific values not in the category menu. All216 linked profiles were attempted uniformly:137 usable HTML responses, one empty HTTP200 body for Bunnings, and78 HTTP429 responses. No retries were made after the bounded extraction. This establishes complete directory-card enumeration, not complete description/status verification. Gong Cha and Lan Spa are explicitly coming/opening soon; Chipmunks advertises opening16May without a year and stays unresolved rather than assumed already trading. JP and Police Beat service facilities are held outside the business denominator. BCF is held because its Hyperdome directory membership conflicts with profile text naming Domain Central Townsville. This leaves210 usable publisher business listings,199 classified non-optical,6 directory optics and5 unclassified non-optical listings (Miss Runway Boutique, Ollies Place, RSEA Safety, RSPCA, Supercheap Auto). The source has26 Home Centre-tagged entries; this scope is included explicitly but is not a separate surveyed property boundary. Broad entertainment and health/fitness tags include goods retailers and remain labelled as broad source categories. A missing profile may contain an unseen future-opening/status qualifier; unverified listings are not independent trading confirmations. Independent ownership remains unknown. Existing five accepted optical census entries and stale source dates stay unchanged; directory Sunglass Hut and published optical fascia variants do not silently alter the public census. Existing source-attributed72,374m² GLA and180-store portfolio claim are reused as property context, with underlying measurement period and reconciliation to the wider216-card directory unresolved. Shailer Park SA2 data is residential context from an authoritative point query, not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Mt Gravatt directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Complete embedded Sitecore StoreDirectory items, native ID/path reconciliation and rendered A–Z cross-check; source subcategories used without SEO vocabulary expansion.
captures.limitations: All 194 native StoreDirectory records across all five source path groups were captured. Rendered A–Z contains 193 matching links with no pagination; Specsavers is the sole payload-only record and remains source-listed, with the display exception documented. 193 directory listings enter present; the Minis family programme is held outside tenant mix. The 175 classified non-optical listings are a known-category denominator; 14 non-optical listings remain unclassified and four optical records are excluded from non-optical mix. Counts include publisher-listed services, community facilities and pop-ups; they are not unique occupied shops or independently verified current trading. Native map references, name aliases, badges and raw taxonomy are retained. Allowed Product SEO Tags are a taxonomy vocabulary, not evidence each shop supplies every allowed service, and are not used as tenant features. captures.capture_method: Every official unfiltered directory page captured, including final incomplete-sized page; native store paths retained.
captures.limitations: Complete available official publisher collection captured; not independently verified daily trading or an occupied-premises census. No operator absence inferred. Unclassified categories stay unknown. Publisher card pages omit some category labels. Missing categories are unclassified, not inferred from presumed brand appeal.
captures.scope: Canonical Robina Town Centre official directory; all available shopping, dining and services records assessed. Neighbouring properties excluded; explicit out-of-scope and future/uncertain records retained in source history.

captures.capture_method: Reused Stockland native-ID/category/detail extractor; full rendered directory loaded to 171 of 171 and reconciled to API.
captures.limitations: Complete official live directory/API reconciliation: 171 of 171 native listings; every linked detail captured once. 171 usable listings, 164 classified non-optical and 7 directory optical records; five accepted census outlets remain unchanged, with stale flags separate. OPSM and Sunglass Hut directory evidence does not silently add census memberships. Four repeated fascias (Amplifon, Casphone, ETUP and Priceline) have distinct native IDs and SAP references; Casphone explicitly describes a second store. Kmart and MyCar share one SAP reference but distinct business activities and IDs; the denominator is publisher business listings, not verified occupied tenancies. One Amplifon heading says Bay Audio, while its directory name and description say Amplifon; no extra business created. All source categories covered uniformly, including uncategorised Lucy’s Head Spa via explicit description. Broad product/service categories remain labelled; ALDI assortment tags do not create standalone fashion/department businesses. Timezone arcade, Event Cinemas and X-Golf establish entertainment; independents remain unknown because local/family ownership does not prove independence. All Coles, Woolworths and ALDI listed; no scoped anchor absences. Official FY26-branded factsheet explicitly reports 58,966 m² GLA, information accurate as at 1 August 2025. Internal date controls over filename. Same value in saved 30 June 2024 sheet; fills unknown structured GLA without reordering frozen queue or claiming a new measurement. FY26 sheet reports 161 specialties, 6.76m MAT traffic and $430.75m MAT sales as at August 2025; undated website has 159, 6.8m and $494.3m. Different windows/methods are unresolved, so no trend or directory denominator is inferred. Its inconsistent Fresh & Save legend is held as a source conflict, not added to the current directory. Population table visually marks 2022 onward as forecasts: 2026 main/total populations 161,929/232,268 remain forecasts from July 2022, not current actuals. Average household incomes $102,847/$104,136 use the historical main/total trade area, not SA2 medians. Source point unchanged; empty resident join remains unknown. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Stockland Rockhampton managed centre at Cnr Yaamba Road and Highway One, North Rockhampton QLD 4701, including explicitly directory-listed external business premises. Other Rockhampton shopping centres and nearby streets remain separate.

captures.capture_method: Complete all-category official directory, all native detail pages and published map CSV; duplicate and non-present review before observation denominator.
captures.limitations: All 142 official directory cards and linked details captured with unique native Drupal node IDs; 20 populated category groups and two additional empty filter options checked. Published map has 145 rows, including five unnamed units that remain raw background, not invented tenants. One map-only ATM is retained, giving 143 captured named records. 139 usable business listings, 133 classified non-optical and 6 optical directory listings. Police Beat, Money Link ATM and the second identical Myer record are held separately. Income Tax Professionals explicitly temporarily closed, retained but not present. Two Myer URLs have identical description/contact and one mapped anchor; raw IDs and duplicate crosswalk retained. Map combines EB Games/ZiNG while directory has separate fascias; listing denominator is not verified unique physical tenancies. Old map slugs, misdirected Crown Currency and inconsistent Wara Sushi links are preserved as discrepancies, not grounds for invented trading status. Reused logos with other-centre alt text do not override explicit local directory membership. Combined categories remain labelled; sporting-products retailer rebel is not classified as an entertainment venue. Independent brand ranges, local and family ownership are not independent-business ownership evidence. Six directory optics do not silently replace three accepted census optics. GLA 44,982 m², site area 94,126 m², parking 2,263 and 150-specialty claim are undated; site area is not GLA and marketing count is not directory coverage. Aitkenvale resident SA2 is not a catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Reused Stockland native-ID/category extraction, all official detail descriptions and SAP references; full rendered directory 108-of-108 verified with load-more controls.
captures.limitations: Complete live directory/API reconciliation: 108 of 108 native listings; every detail page captured once. 107 enter presence; Prouds remains held because its description names Stockland Rockhampton despite the Hervey Bay directory and SAP location reference. 104 usable non-optical records classified and 3 directory optical aliases, distinct from unchanged accepted census. 4 descriptions blank; no missing activity or trading status invented. Combined pharmacy/cosmetics, fresh-food/liquor, services/medical and broad entertainment taxonomy remain labelled; only explicit Timezone arcade/laser-tag activity establishes an entertainment venue. Sport First explicitly states all stores independently owned; this supports the source ownership claim but not absence of other independents. Hervey Bay Travel and Transit Centre is explicitly a travel booking business at the bus interchange and is included. Official FY25-branded leasing factsheet explicitly labels 36,851 m² as GLA, with information accurate as at 30 June 2024. The internal date controls rather than the FY25 filename. This dated measure fills an unknown field; no current measurement or silent queue reorder. Leasing sheet dated 30 June 2024 reports 99 specialty stores under its own less-than-400m² definition, not a directory denominator. Its 4.87m MAT traffic is historical with measurement method unknown. Trade-area map and demographics are dated July 2022/ABS2021: 107,700 is 2022 population, 112,700 a 2026 forecast, and $74,309 average annual household income is not resident-SA2 median income. None is relabelled a measured 2026 shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Coomera directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Official readable directory followed through every advertised pagination link; link/image echoes removed, duplicate listing names retained, page/ordinal source references preserved.
captures.limitations: All 11 advertised directory pages captured; 24 records per full page and 15 on the terminal page. Total is enumerated pagination, not an independently published tenancy count. Reader cache ages vary: 5 days ago, today. Categories use official filters, explicit activity names or existing attributed classifications. Category-page gaps: [{'category': 'Beauty and wellness', 'missing_pages': [2, 3]}]. Unclassified categories and ownership remain unknown. Listing statuses may be omitted by the readable source; current trading is not independently checked. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Marion directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Reused Westfield readable-page extractor, every advertised A–Z page; 24 entries per full page, terminal page reconciled; link/image echoes removed and page-ordinal source IDs retained.
captures.limitations: All 10 advertised A–Z pages captured; 233 enumerated listings, not an independently verified occupied-tenancy count. Readable publisher cache ages: ['2 weeks ago', '5 days ago', '6 days ago', 'last month']. Mixed cache dates can affect pagination and names. Complete means all available advertised pages, not a same-time live census. All retail categories are included by the unfiltered directory. Supplemental category filters have these gaps: [{"category": "banks", "page": 1, "reason": "6 months ago old supplementary cache excluded; names can still have other attributed classification evidence"}]. Other supplementary cache ages are retained per record; exact-name joins only, unmatched aliases remain unknown. Source categories may span broad activities; independent ownership and individual trading are unverified. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Reused Westfield native-ID/category crosswalk; complete server-rendered pagination and category routes, with 22 focused detail checks for uniform taxonomy/facility review.
captures.limitations: Complete official directory: 198 unique native IDs over 9 unfiltered pages, plus every one of 32 category filters and 37 category pages. Each advertised pagination link captured once; last pages have no next link; category URL/title and filtered cards verified (server select HTML keeps empty default). Four centre facilities retained outside business counts, leaving 194 usable listings and 187 classified non-optical, with 7 directory optical listings separate from five unchanged accepted census outlets. Sunglass Hut and The Optical Superstore directory evidence do not silently add census memberships. Eight initial detail reviews cover both uncategorised entries, facilities and repeated All Around Massage premises; fourteen further details cover the entire broad entertainment filter, liquor/therapy/service ambiguities and optical aliases. NK Fashion explicitly describes youth fashion. All Around Massage and Mister Minit variants have separate source IDs and explicit different locations. Broad entertainment includes product retailers: only Reading Cinemas gains the specific venue category; Kumon is education and Lollipop Collective baby/child product retail. Dan Murphy and Liquorland remain liquor, not grocery observations. Kid Sense is an evidenced therapy business; Bupa Health retains broad source classification and stays separate from Bupa Optical. Independent ownership remains unknown; local small-business wording is insufficient. Other combined categories retain their source scope; individual unreviewed details and all trading remain unverified. Existing 71,400 m² GLA, 216 tenants and 7.1m annual visits are reused dated portfolio evidence, not fresh measurements or extraction denominators. Owner webpage February 2026 uses 2025 population/expenditure estimates (over 226,000 total-trade-area residents, $4.0bn total/$3.1bn main expenditure) with transaction-defined scope; boundary map unavailable and never replaced by West Lakes SA2 resident data. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all captured names and possible fascia variants in the complete publisher directory. No listing found; absence is confined to this captured directory, not independently verified physical trading absence.

captures.capture_method: Complete published WordPress store collection with total/page headers, full category taxonomy, and exact URL reconciliation to the all-category live directory; separate complete HTML map-list crosswalk.
captures.limitations: Complete primary live directory: 87 unique published store IDs and all 87 rendered listing URLs agree, including shopping, dining and services; final No Stores Remain marker observed. Complete secondary map table has 83 non-empty rows, retained separately with aliases and source row IDs rather than counted twice. Platinum Spinal Centre appears only on that map, shares 94B with Kingston Chiropractic Solutions, and remains currency-unresolved rather than counted present. Live directory records may share suites (Services Australia, Medicare and Service Tasmania at 87A), and Tai Chi lists two shops under one record; listing counts are not occupied-tenancy counts. All 85 non-optical records have source-supported categories; Fresh Food & Liquor is retained as a combined label and only explicit grocery/liquor descriptions add narrower categories. No independent ownership is inferred from names or presumed brand fit; two descriptions explicitly state independently owned. Hobart Eye Surgeons is a health service, not assumed to be an optical retail store. Two optical directory listings are separate from the unchanged one accepted census outlet; Specsavers mapping to the wider Channel Highway corridor is not silently reassigned. Source descriptions and names sometimes contain template text, spelling errors or possible copy errors (Natures Works); original content retained. Brochure July 2024 retail GLA 25,274 m² is dated source evidence, not a current survey; its 3M annual traffic period/method and trade-area boundary are unspecified. Brochure demographics sourced to ABS 2021/Gap Maps remain unjoined background, distinct from the existing Kingston–Huntingfield SA2 resident figures. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Parsed publisher-rendered directory configuration and cards on both advertised pages; native IDs matched to all linked detail pages for full source taxonomy and explicit descriptions.
captures.limitations: All 53/53 available publisher listings captured across both unfiltered A–Z pages, and all 53 linked detail pages reviewed uniformly on 2026-10-12. One atmX facility record covers two ATMs and remains outside the 52 tenant/business denominator. Source categories, including the publisher typo Profesional, are retained; General is not assigned a specific activity without explicit name/description evidence. Publisher categories may overlap or be broad (for example Cotton On is tagged Beauty); this capture reports the source rather than inferring brand affinity. Family-owned, franchised and national-chain wording is retained without inventing independent ownership. Open/Closed badges describe opening hours, not verified trading or permanent closure. The leasing page claims over 55 specialty retailers plus anchors, which does not reconcile with the 53 published records; the difference remains unresolved and is not treated as missing physical tenancies. The supplier Street financial-format label remains intact alongside the accepted physical Shopping Centre format. Existing OPSM/BrightEyes membership repairs and two accepted census outlets are reused unchanged. GLA remains unknown: an older planning-file size reference could not be retrieved and has no verified current definition/date. No Ballina Central property figures are borrowed. Resident-area context is not a measured centre catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

All raw references and holds are retained; this is complete primary-directory extraction, not verified physical tenancy completeness. Category combinations remain combined; independent ownership remains unknown. The existing three accepted optical census stores and stale source dates are unchanged; the additional Sunglass Hut directory listing does not silently alter the public census. GLA 18,552 sqm is attributed to the manager at 30 June 2026; promotional 95+/100+ retailer claims are not directory denominators. Resident SA2 context remains broader display-polygon background; forecast growth and promotional regional reach are not a measured shopper catchment. captures.capture_method: Full official websiteData store array and published category taxonomy, reconciled by unique publisher UUID. Same reused Vicinity extractor as earlier captures.
captures.limitations: All publisher store-array records across categories retained, including coming-soon listings held from presence. Publisher category combinations retained; facilities separately held. Directory capture does not independently verify current trading or occupied premises. No ownership is inferred.
captures.scope: Named canonical shopping-centre directory; neighbouring properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Reused complete live Westfield DOM pagination and every category filter, joined by native store ID. Reconciled settled URL/label states, reviewed all uncategorised/facility records plus category and duplicate anomalies.
captures.limitations: All nine unfiltered A–Z pages (193 unique IDs) and all 31 category filters (36 settled pages) captured. Four facilities held, leaving 189 usable source business/service listings and 186 classified non-optical observations. Three directory optics match the unchanged accepted census. Transient empty/mislabelled category states are retained raw and excluded by URL/label reconciliation. An earlier Home filter exposed one additional native ID, 6KoseM83cBi9rnbbU49tLy, absent from A–Z and the later live 22-card Home recheck; this publisher/hydration discrepancy remains unresolved without inventing its identity. Broad categories describe publisher tagging, not verified principal activity; Baby Bunting Childcare tagging does not establish a childcare service, and two liquor stores are classified from explicit details. Bottlemart expressly claims independent ownership; other ownership unknown. Detail review covers all unclassified/facility and identified duplicate/category anomalies, not an ownership census. New Spicy grocery variants have different contact/location details and remain separate source IDs; BWS is described inside Woolworths. Existing 63,400 m² portfolio GLA with source date 24 February 2026 is reused, not a new measurement; 185 portfolio tenancies are not the directory coverage denominator. Mill Park–North SA2 residents are not a centre catchment. No new coordinates, demographics or optical memberships. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Full official websiteData store array and published category taxonomy, reconciled by unique publisher UUID. Same reused Vicinity extractor as earlier captures.
captures.limitations: All publisher store-array records across categories retained, including coming-soon listings held from presence. Publisher category combinations retained; facilities separately held. Directory capture does not independently verify current trading or occupied premises. No ownership is inferred.
captures.scope: Named canonical shopping-centre directory; neighbouring properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Complete live Westfield DOM pagination and every published category filter, joined by native publisher ID; otherwise uncategorised listings and suspected facilities reviewed on their official detail pages.
captures.limitations: All 7 unfiltered pages and all 30 official category filters (33 pages) captured, with native-ID and pagination checks. 154 published listings include seven non-tenant facilities: parcel locker, concierge, gift card, prize desk, Giftmas concierge zone, recycling point and EV charging station. 147 usable business/service observations include 144 classified non-optical listings and three optical listings matching the unchanged accepted census. Both otherwise uncategorised Lucky Charm records explicitly describe newsagency franchises, with distinct centre locations and phone numbers; Pokero also has two explicitly different locations with separate IDs and shared phone. These are publisher premises observations, not verified occupancy. All eight detail checks and source categories retained; category combinations are not split into assumed activities. The older 160-tenant compendium figure and owner 149+ specialties use different dates/definitions, not extraction denominators. Reused attributed GLA 52,900 sqm is not a new current measurement. Owner population about 397,000 and retail expenditure estimates refer to 2025 transaction-defined trade areas, with webpage currency February 2026; trade-area map was not captured. Existing Airport West SA2 residents are not that catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Doncaster directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction, following each visible next-page control through terminal page. Stable store identifiers preserved; every published category filter captured and joined by publisher ID.
captures.limitations: All 14 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (43 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 328 publisher listings, with 5 facility records retained outside tenant/business observations. Directory enumeration is not independently verified physical tenancy occupancy or current trading. Category membership is the publisher’s classification and can be broad, surprising or incomplete; no brand-affinity overrides are applied. The two Concierge IDs, gift card, prize collection desk and parcel locker are facilities. Listed community, professional, education and health services remain included. Gumnuts Playland is a named operator with booking, café and party services on its official detail page and is not presumed to be a centre amenity. Knox Library is a listed community service; no unsupported source category is supplied. Distinct publisher IDs and same-name listings are retained; these are not necessarily distinct reconciled premises. Source category page URLs and actual selected controls establish classification, not a stale requested-category transport label; blank dropdowns on paginated pages are resolved from their visible next-page links. Transient empty renders are preserved and do not establish absence. The dated compendium value of 376 businesses and 141,400 m² GLA remain separate source-attributed measures, not the current directory denominator. Existing seven accepted optical outlets are unchanged; eight optical directory listings include Sunglass Hut without automatically adding another census point. Prior Optimax Knox repair is reused, retaining the distinction from Burwood NSW. The Wantirna South resident-area data are not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Southland directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: All published store-listings REST pages, X-WP-Total reconciled; applied the exact directory frontend tax_query terms 26/25/83.
captures.limitations: Published CMS records reconciled by stable ID order; frontend taxonomy applied. Repeated normalized names count once for brand presence. The FAQ claim of 143 stores does not reconcile to this available directory and is not an occupancy denominator. Source categories contain broad combined labels; uncategorised ownership stays unknown. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Server-rendered all-category directory table and every associated store panel; exact ID/name reconciliation and source category-filter labels reused.
captures.limitations: All 70 available directory/sidebar entries and 70 corresponding store-detail panels reconciled by published store/map ID. Source categories retained across all categories; one uncategorised listing remains unknown. Posted weekly hours are publisher information, not independent current-trading verification. Duplicate business names with distinct store IDs are retained as listings, not asserted distinct operators. Current GLA and occupied-tenancy totals are unavailable. Official Stage 3 page describes construction and a future seven-screen cinema; future facilities are not counted as present. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Reused Vicinity/Storyblok extractor: matching complete websiteData.stores arrays, all taxonomy IDs resolved, shopping/dining link union applied, full profile of every source ID reviewed.
captures.limitations: Captured all 195 native source records and profiles; 193 unique links in shopping/dining lists. JD Sports and Redi ATM remain scope holds; the latter is also a facility. Three Coming Soon records stay excluded, with TK Maxx explicitly scheduled for 15 October 2026 and Three Grains relocating. Zambrero has a closure notice with no year/reopening confirmation conflicting with normal listed hours, so remains unresolved. Shingle Inn stays a published dining observation with blank description and all regular hours missing; no trading claim. 189 usable listings, 183 classified non-optical and 6 directory optics; unchanged four accepted census outlets. All categories and descriptions reviewed, including ordinary services/independents; Expert Hearing Care explicitly states independent ownership while other ownership remains unknown. Broad retail categories are retained; games/media retailers do not prove entertainment venues. Complete publisher capture is not occupied-tenancy/trading verification. Dated 65,415 m² GLA and 6.6m visits at 31 December 2025 reused; owner 195 tenants is not the current listing denominator. Owner 128,418 TTA is a different geography from resident Mandurah SA2, based on 2021-derived demographics. Income $81,392 is labelled Average on page but medianIncome internally, with period undefined: not a comparable median. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

absence_reviews.label: ALDI
absence_reviews.basis: Reviewed all captured names and possible fascia variants in the complete publisher directory. No listing found; absence is confined to this captured directory, not independently verified physical trading absence.

captures.capture_method: Complete embedded websiteData.stores arrays; deduplicated native IDs; reconciled union of shopping and food rendered listing links.
captures.limitations: Complete available publisher array: 97 records, independently reconciled across shopping and food payloads; 85 shopping links union 17 food links equals all 97 directory links. 94 source-listed rows enter presence; Myer, House, Gentle Nails are held as temporarily closed. 12 usable non-optical rows lack a conservative category mapping and remain unclassified, with original categories retained. Directory capture is not a verified occupancy or trading census. New-location flags do not establish new unit numbers; Options exact current unit remains unknown. Redevelopment page has a generic all-stores-open FAQ conflicting with its specific Myer closure notice; the specific closure and directory flag prevail. Future ACE HOYTS and announced fashion tenants are not current presence. The directory Entertainment & Leisure category includes book retail and is not proof of an operating cinema. Historical owner GLA is reused with its 31 December 2025 date. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.scope: Official canonical centre directory; shopping, food and services included; nearby properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: Reused complete Vicinity/Storyblok source-array extractor, full profile review for every native ID, taxonomy mapping and shopping/dining link-union reconciliation.
captures.limitations: Complete source array and all 195 native profiles captured; 193 shopping/dining links reconciled. 190 usable business listings represent 186 distinct names; 184 classified non-optical listings and 6 optical directory records. Four accepted census outlets retained separately without adding or merging directory-only records. Source names recur for Yalda Beauty, Barber Nation, House and CKF Massage with different unit IDs; do not interpret listing counts as distinct occupied tenancies. Three ATM records are facilities and held. JK Barbers and Chatime lack source categories and are absent from the shopping/dining union; JK Barbers also appears on the owner floorplan, so scope discrepancy is explicit, not closure. Blank descriptions retain explicit source categories without invented details. All categories reviewed, including supermarkets, dining, services, health, entertainment, fashion and beauty. Owner GLA 61,965 m² and 7.4m annual visits are dated 31 December 2025; its 188 tenants are not the current capture denominator. Owner TTA 226,098 and 2021-derived demographics are a different geography from resident SA2. Income $99,284 is labelled Average but keyed medianIncome with no period; comparison unresolved. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered publisher directory pagination through final page; structured tenant IDs and literal categories cross-checked against rendered cards.
captures.limitations: All available publisher listings captured, including retail, health, services, entertainment and dining. This is not independent verification that every business trades today, an occupied-unit census or a catchment boundary. Publisher categories can be broad. No missing operator is declared absent.
captures.scope: Official canonical Westfield Carousel directory, every unfiltered published page. Nearby properties and other centres excluded by explicit source centreSlug.

captures.capture_method: Existing Westfield readable-page extractor, every advertised A–Z page; 24 entries per full page, terminal page reconciled; link/image echoes removed and page-ordinal source IDs retained.
captures.limitations: All 10 advertised A–Z pages captured; 238 enumerated listings, not an independently verified occupied-tenancy count. Direct official fetch returned HTTP 403; readable cache ages range from 4 days to last week. Mixed cache dates can affect pagination and names. Complete means all available advertised pages, not a same-time live census. All retail categories are included by the unfiltered directory. Supplemental category filters have gaps: [{"category": "beauty-and-wellness", "page": 2, "reason": "Readable source unavailable; no absence or classification inferred"}, {"category": "professional-services", "reason": "1.1-year-old cache excluded from current supplementary classification"}]. Categories from older caches are attributed separately; exact-name joins only, unmatched aliases remain unknown. Services and literal activity evidence are retained; independent ownership and individual trading are unverified. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Complete A–Z HTML index plus every linked store taxonomy profile; native term IDs, category names and explicit location descriptions retained.
captures.limitations: Complete current A–Z directory: 115 official records, all native taxonomy IDs and full profiles reviewed. Centre Management is a facility hold; 114 business listings enter presence, including 19 explicitly tagged office businesses. 110 classified non-optical listings and 4 optical directory observations; two accepted census outlets remain unchanged. Official scope includes indoor centre, Maki Street/Town Square and offices; do not compare listing composition with indoor retail-only directories as equivalent occupied-tenancy samples. No neighbouring Westgate properties inferred. Older Maki/promotional pages name additional historical retailers not in the current index; these are not promoted. Linked December 2025 PDF exceeded the capture size cap and was not reviewed; current HTML profiles are complete. Source category Travel & Leisure includes a gym, arcade and musical-instrument retailer, classified by actual described activity. Independent non-optical ownership remains unknown; explicit independent Westgate optometry is recorded separately. Complete directory capture does not verify trading or current occupied units. Approximate 32,500 m² GLA is explicitly stage 1+2 scope but source/measurement date unknown; 2026-09-02 was an earlier verification date. Approximate 475,000 within a 15-minute drive is undated with no model/boundary, not a comparable resident or shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Official all=1 directory, all native store/eatery cards captured from unfiltered response.
captures.limitations: Complete available official publisher collection captured; not independently verified daily trading or an occupied-premises census. No operator absence inferred. Unclassified categories stay unknown. Explicitly labelled Sylvia Park Lifestyle listings are captured but excluded from the Mall scope; they do not establish mall co-tenancy.
captures.scope: Canonical Sylvia Park Mall official directory; all available shopping, dining and services records assessed. Neighbouring properties excluded; explicit out-of-scope and future/uncertain records retained in source history.

captures.capture_method: Complete two-page rendered all-category index plus every linked full official tenant profile and native post ID; dining index reconciled as subset.
captures.limitations: Complete current publisher directory 104/104 with all full profiles, native post IDs and two-page browser index; 24 dining listings are a subset, not added again. 103 usable business listings: 101 classified non-optical and two optical observations, matching two unchanged accepted census outlets. BNZ stays non-present/uncertain because an undated refurbishment closure conflicts with routine hours; Closed now elsewhere is only a daily hours indicator. Includes two explicitly named Catherine Plaza businesses outside the enclosed mall, so this is not an indoor-only sample. Pita Pit and NZ Natural are separate publisher records; distinct occupied-unit count unverified. Family, whanau, franchise and trust ownership claims retained without converting them to independent-business presence. Card Merchant explicitly offers weekly organised play; toy/merchandise retailers are not entertainment venues just because of products. Live total 104 differs from undated over110/over130 marketing claims. Current GLA and comparable catchment unknown; 36,281 m² and population figures are historical as at December 2015, not current. Full directory coverage does not verify trading. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Official exposed AEM collection, all results and totalCount reconciled; no further page.
captures.limitations: Complete available official publisher collection captured; not independently verified daily trading or an occupied-premises census. No operator absence inferred. Unclassified categories stay unknown.
captures.scope: Canonical Bayfair Shopping Centre official directory; all available shopping, dining and services records assessed. Neighbouring properties excluded; explicit out-of-scope and future/uncertain records retained in source history.

captures.capture_method: Both full public paginated indexes and all linked full profiles with native WordPress IDs, supplemented by explicitly held map-only business labels; all raw map labels retained for audit.
captures.limitations: Complete current indexes: 83 shop plus 22 dining profiles, both paginated to first empty response, 105 unique native posts/full profiles. Five map-only business labels retained as unresolved holds; with these the evidence denominator is 110 records. BNZ is an ATM-only facility hold. 104 usable business listings, 102 classified non-optical and two optical directory observations; accepted census remains one Specsavers outlet. Includes open-air retail and Lifestyle Centre as explicitly published, not an indoor-only sample. Travelex is inside House of Travel and Warehouse Stationery is within The Warehouse; listing counts are not distinct occupied premises. Five map-only businesses (Barkers, Relax, Phone Life, Farmer Auto Village, Early Settler) remain unknown; Barkers profile 404 is not proof of closure. Map has old links, repeated IDs and incorrect categories (PAK’nSAVE tagged health/beauty); full profile activity takes precedence. The Phone Shop description is blank; name supports technology retail only. Independent ownership directly supported for The Crossing Pharmacy; family/local/network descriptions elsewhere do not prove local independence. Current GLA and comparable catchment unknown. Undated claim of just over 350,000 total trade area lacks year/model/boundary. Linked 2025 brochure exceeds the 6 MB capture cap and the web parser limit, so not reviewed; historical development schedule not presumed completed. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

East/West scope includes separately owned Woolworths, The Warehouse, Noel Leeming and Plus Fitness by explicit publisher membership, not shared ownership. Woolworths profile explicitly reconciles old Countdown map label. Warehouse Stationery and The Warehouse separate profiles need not be distinct standalone premises. Viva la Moda product-range COMING SOON text is not a future store flag. Retail products and generic bookable events do not automatically establish an entertainment venue; independent local ownership remains unknown. Current GLA and comparable catchment unavailable; district marketing, historical management charts and unrelated office sizes are not substitutes. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: All official A–Z profiles and two category indexes reconciled by canonical URLs to all centre-map units; full descriptions uniformly reviewed.
captures.limitations: All 67 A–Z profiles captured and reconciled to all 67 centre-map entries; Shop 48 and Eat/Drink 22 overlap to the same 67 unique URLs, with no pagination or load-more control. Complete scope includes upper-floor offices, health and service businesses. Explicit shop IDs, levels, URL slugs and modified timestamps retained; page updates/opening hours do not verify current trading. Pavilion and three food concepts share E-01, while Barkers/Max share D-04; source listing totals are not distinct premises. Iron + Ivy index alias resolves to Iron and Ivy Hair Studio. Source taxonomy is broad; all full descriptions reviewed with activity-specific corrections. Adventure product retail and incidental board games at a restaurant do not establish an entertainment venue. Independent ownership unknown. Two directory optical profiles vs one accepted census record are separate evidence, with no silent census promotion. Leasing page describes retail/recreation/commercial development and a next stage but supplies no defined current GLA, occupied-unit denominator or shopper catchment. Adjacent Five Mile/Remarkables Park excluded. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.limitations: Complete available Shop and Dine indexes: 44 linked full profiles plus Balibu’s unlinked logo listing, 45 usable business records. Four map-only names remain held: EB Games, Westpac, Otto’s Corner Store and Geobyte. The latter three are within a separately labelled 25 Esk Street map block; no current mall membership inferred. Evidence denominator 49 includes those four holds. Six unlinked shop tiles are category headings and Esk Eats is a precinct logo, not extra tenants. Ten image filenames say COMING SOON but visually inspected tiles do not; full current profiles lack future flags. Native Squarespace collection and index-block IDs retained. Mister Mint meta typo resolved to visible Mister Minit. Barkers/Max share one mapped unit; combined Sushi & Bento/Noodle Noodle profile covers two labels. Counts are source businesses, not occupied tenancies. Balibu has no detailed profile or hours. Independent ownership unknown; no optical listings found in directory but parent census scope is unverified, so no optical absence asserted and neighbouring corridor records remain unchanged. Current GLA/catchment unknown; historical 2022 constructed area includes atriums/amenities and staged plans, not current GLA. Undated advertising claim over 30,000 weekly visitors is not measured annual footfall. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Entire official A-Z directory page; unique store detail paths retained across all alphabet groups.
captures.limitations: All available A-Z name links captured, including facility entries held separately. No published total independently reconciles occupancy; no source categories were supplied by this A-Z page. Directory capture does not independently verify current trading or occupied premises. No ownership is inferred.
captures.scope: Named canonical shopping-centre directory; neighbouring properties excluded.

captures.capture_method: All linked store headings and all full profiles from the current complete publisher index, retaining native store IDs and source filter slugs.
captures.limitations: All 159 linked store entries and full profiles captured from the complete all-category publisher index; unlinked No Results Found placeholder excluded. 156 usable businesses: 152 classified non-optical, one unclassified Pop Stop, and three optical directory observations. ASB and Max remain coming-soon, while New Zealand Post post boxes are a facility hold. BNZ Saturday-only closure and Classy Nail Salon future pedicure service do not establish whole-business closure. Historical Hype DC 2021 opening text and Walker & Hall old coming-soon URL do not override current listing titles. In Sweet Coffee, Number One Shoes and Pagani have blank descriptions but explicit categories; Pop Stop has neither. Complete directory coverage is not verified trading. Identity consolidated as Te Awa at The Base on 2026-10-16; original source capture date and raw publisher identifiers retained. Directory optical listings remain separate from independently accepted census membership. Columbus is inside Mitre 10; counts are business records, not occupied tenancies. Independent ownership unknown. Owner 153 tenants/joint-owner about160 stores differ from captured record count; no forced reconciliation. Owner 88,635 sqm is undated NLA, not GLA; joint-owner31hectares is site area. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

captures.capture_method: Full native WordPress post objects embedded in two matching official directory/map arrays, including descriptions, all category labels, levels and source IDs; rendered browser index reconciled.
captures.limitations: Complete publisher directory: 104 native post records, full embedded profiles in two identical arrays, reconciled against 104 unique rendered directory URLs. 96 usable business listings, including 8 office businesses; 94 classified non-optical and 2 optical directory records. Five advertised vacancies and two coming-soon listings are non-present; centre management is a facility hold. Current titles take precedence over historical slugs such as eb-games (Acai Era coming soon), the-body-shop (vacancy), vacant (Pandora), for-lease (Platypus), and bnz-opening-soon (current BNZ listing). All source IDs and slugs retained. Shared map-unit IDs are publisher inconsistencies, not proven duplicate businesses or occupancy. No independently owned non-optical business established; Welly Collective represents one listing, not 140 separate tenant records. Full directory coverage does not verify trading. Office-inclusive composition is not equivalent to retail-only directories. New World appears in parking directions, not the tenant directory; membership is not inferred and its absence remains unknown. Older Body Shop references are not promoted. Owner tenancy components are undated and may overlap; no whole-centre GLA or defined catchment established. Savills 48.20 m² is one office unit, not centre GLA. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
